limits: Browser-only independent interpreter; full Stata command, ado and Mata compatibility remains unfinished.

deploymentRepair.cause: Unrelated identity test sent a scalar answer to a randomly selected multipart question. Forced multipart fixture reproduced the failure.
deploymentRepair.repair: The test now constructs the correct answer shape and checks both sampled and forced-multipart questions. No application logic changed.

followupObservations.failure: A public verification repeat timed out while Playwright scrolled the Practice builder link into view.
followupObservations.investigation: The same lesson-to-builder sequence was repeated in isolation; the link opened the builder in 45 ms.
followupObservations.cause: Not established; no application fix claimed.

followupObservations.failure: Another repeat reported invalid gzip data from the site-wide Pagefind loader.
followupObservations.investigation: An isolated public search returned the expected results. All requested Pagefind assets returned HTTP 200, and compressed index files had valid gzip headers.
followupObservations.cause: Not established; no application fix claimed.

finalVerification: A subsequent complete public pass succeeded in all 16 groups, after both deployments; earlier intermittent failures remain recorded.
